newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 scales new peaks on rate outlook.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 scales new peaks on rate outlook.

text.p: Britain's leading blue- chip index charged further into record ground on Thursday as investors cheered a signal from the Bank of England that its quarter-point interest rate hike was likely to be the last for a while, strategists and dealers said.
The FTSE 100 share index climbed 60.6 points to a fresh closing peak at 5,086.8. So far this week, the index has jumped 179.3 points, adding more than 30 billion stg to its value.
Gains were broad-based, with advancers outpacing decliners 86 to 12. Volume was heavy, with 1.12 billion shares registered by 1543 GMT.
